title: centaurea nigra subsp. nemoralis
intro: Centaurea nigra subsp. nemoralis, commonly known as Woodland knapweed, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea nigra subsp. nemoralis include its use as an anti-oxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may help in reducing inflammation and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
